interpretation_limit: SPEI dry-event classes have upper-inclusive boundaries. The table caption says SPI, but its entries and surrounding section explicitly describe SPEI. This defines event severity, not thresholds for long-term drought frequency. Copernicus and CSIC datasets use different derivations; transfer requires review.
